    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`When customizing Maximo Mobile applications, the method you choose for applying configurations has significant implications for maintainability, upgrade compatibility, and long-term support. This guide explains the recommended approaches and why certain practices should be avoided.`}</p>
    <p>{`There are three primary methods for applying configurations:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Using AppCustomizations.js`}</strong>{` (✅ Recommended)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Extending base JavaScript classes`}</strong>{` (✅ Recommended for complex scenarios)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Directly modifying base controllers`}</strong>{` (❌ Not Recommended)`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p>{`Understanding when and how to use each approach is critical for creating maintainable customizations that survive version upgrades.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Why This Matters:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`The configuration approach you choose directly impacts:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Upgrade success`}</strong>{` - Whether your customizations survive version updates`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Maintenance effort`}</strong>{` - How much work is required to maintain customizations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Technical debt`}</strong>{` - Long-term cost of supporting your customizations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Team productivity`}</strong>{` - How easily others can understand and modify your work`}</li>
    </ul>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Method 1: Using AppCustomizations.js (Recommended)`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Overview`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` file is the `}<strong parentName="p">{`primary and recommended location`}</strong>{` for all application customizations. This file is specifically designed to persist through Maximo Mobile upgrades, making it the safest place for your custom logic.`}</p>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` file acts as a `}<strong parentName="p">{`global controller`}</strong>{` for your entire application. Any event handler that can be defined in datasources, dialogs, pages, or the application itself can be implemented within `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{`. This includes:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Application lifecycle events (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`applicationInitialized`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`applicationResumed`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Page lifecycle events (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageResumed`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pagePaused`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Dialog lifecycle events (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`dialogInitialized`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`dialogOpened`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`dialogClosed`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Datasource events (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`onDatasourceInitialized`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`onAfterLoadData`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`onBeforeLoadData`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Custom event handlers defined in your XML configuration`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`This centralized approach means you can intercept and customize any event in your application from a single, upgrade-safe location.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Why Use AppCustomizations.js`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Benefits:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Upgrade-safe`}</strong>{` - This file carries over during version upgrades`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Centralized`}</strong>{` - All customizations in one location for easy maintenance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Global scope`}</strong>{` - Can handle events from any component in the application`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Clear separation`}</strong>{` - Distinguishes custom code from base framework code`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Event interception`}</strong>{` - Can intercept any event before or after base controllers`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Trade-offs:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`⚠️ May require adjustments when APIs are deprecated between versions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`⚠️ Developers need to monitor release notes for API changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`⚠️ Functions may need refactoring if underlying framework behavior changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`⚠️ Can grow quite large as a singular file, making readability and navigation challenging`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Basic Structure`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` file follows a standard class-based structure with lifecycle methods:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Application customization file
 * This file persists through upgrades - place all custom logic here
 * Acts as a global controller for the entire application
 */
const TAG = 'AppCustomizations';

class AppCustomizations {
  
  /**
   * Called when the application initializes
   * @param {Object} app - The application instance
   */
  applicationInitialized(app) {
    this.app = app;
    this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Application initialized - applying customizations');
    
    // Initialize your customizations
    this.registerEventHandlers();
    this.applyCustomConfigurations();
  }
  
  /**
   * Called when a page is initialized
   * @param {Object} page - The page instance
   * @param {Object} app - The application instance
   */
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    const pageTag = \`\${TAG}.pageInitialized\`;
    this.app.log.d(pageTag, \`Page initialized: \${page.name}\`);
    
    // Page-specific customizations
    if (page.name === 'workDetail') {
      this.customizeWorkDetailPage(page);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Called when a datasource is initialized
   * @param {Object} datasource - The datasource instance
   * @param {Object} owner - The owner (page or app)
   * @param {Object} app - The application instance
   */
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.onDatasourceInitialized\`;
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Datasource initialized: \${datasource.name}\`);
    
    // Datasource-specific customizations
    if (datasource.name === 'workorderDS') {
      this.customizeWorkOrderDatasource(datasource);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Called when a dialog is initialized
   * @param {Object} dialog - The dialog instance
   */
  dialogInitialized(dialog) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.dialogInitialized\`;
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Dialog initialized: \${dialog.name}\`);
    
    // Dialog-specific customizations
    if (dialog.name === 'woStatusChangeDialog') {
      this.customizeStatusChangeDialog(dialog);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Register custom event handlers
   */
  registerEventHandlers() {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.registerEventHandlers\`;
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Registering custom event handlers');
    
    // Add your event handlers here
  }
  
  /**
   * Apply custom configurations
   */
  applyCustomConfigurations() {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.applyCustomConfigurations\`;
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Applying custom configurations');
    
    // Add your configurations here
  }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Common Customization Patterns`}</h3>
    <h4>{`Pattern 1: Wrapping Existing Methods`}</h4>
    <p>{`When you need to add logic before or after an existing method without replacing it entirely:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Wrap an existing controller method to add custom logic
 */
pageInitialized(page, app) {
  if (page.name === 'workDetail') {
    const controller = page.findController((c) => c.constructor.name === 'WorkOrderDetailController');
    
    if (!controller) {
      this.app.log.w(TAG, 'WorkOrderDetailController not found');
      return;
    }
    
    // Save reference to original method
    const originalSaveMethod = controller.saveWorkOrder.bind(controller);
    
    // Replace with wrapped version
    controller.saveWorkOrder = async function() {
      const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.saveWorkOrder\`;
      app.log.d(methodTag, 'Custom pre-save logic executing');
      
      // Add custom validation before save
      if (!this.validateCustomRequirements()) {
        app.toast('Custom validation failed', 'error');
        return false;
      }
      
      // Call original method
      const result = await originalSaveMethod();
      
      // Add custom logic after save
      if (result) {
        app.log.d(methodTag, 'Custom post-save logic executing');
        await this.performCustomPostSaveActions();
      }
      
      return result;
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Custom validation logic
 */
validateCustomRequirements() {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.validateCustomRequirements\`;
  this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Performing custom validation');
  
  const woDS = this.app.findDatasource('workorderDS');
  if (!woDS || !woDS.item) {
    this.app.log.w(methodTag, 'Work order datasource or item not found');
    return false;
  }
  
  const workorder = woDS.item;
  
  // Example: Require actual finish date for completed work orders
  if (workorder.status === 'COMP' && !workorder.actfinish) {
    this.app.log.w(methodTag, 'Actual finish date missing');
    return false;
  }
  
  return true;
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Pattern 2: Event Handler Registration`}</h4>
    <p>{`Subscribe to application or datasource events:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Register custom event handlers
 */
applicationInitialized(app) {
  this.app = app;
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.applicationInitialized\`;
  
  // Listen for datasource events
  this.app.on('onAfterLoadData', (event) => {
    const { datasource, items } = event;
    
    if (datasource.name === 'woListDS') {
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Loaded \${items.length} work orders\`);
      this.processLoadedWorkOrders(items);
    }
  });
  
  // Listen for value changes
  this.app.on('onValueChanged', (event) => {
    const { datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue } = event;
    
    if (datasource.name === 'workorderDS' && field === 'status') {
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Status changed from \${oldValue} to \${newValue}\`);
      this.handleStatusChange(item, oldValue, newValue);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Process loaded work orders
 */
processLoadedWorkOrders(items) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.processLoadedWorkOrders\`;
  this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Processing loaded work orders');
  
  // Add custom processing logic
  items.forEach(item => {
    // Example: Calculate custom field
    item.customPriority = this.calculateCustomPriority(item);
  });
}

/**
 * Handle status changes
 */
handleStatusChange(item, oldValue, newValue) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.handleStatusChange\`;
  this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Handling status change for WO \${item.wonum}\`);
  
  // Example: Clear fields when status changes
  if (newValue === 'COMP') {
    // Ensure required fields are populated
    if (!item.actfinish) {
      item.actfinish = new Date();
    }
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Pattern 3: Datasource Customization`}</h4>
    <p>{`Modify datasource behavior and queries:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Customize datasource when it initializes
 */
onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.onDatasourceInitialized\`;
  
  if (datasource.name === 'workorderDS') {
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Customizing work order datasource');
    
    // Add custom query parameters
    datasource.options.query = {
      ...datasource.options.query,
      customFilter: 'priority>2'
    };
    
    // Modify select clause
    if (!datasource.options.select.includes('customfield')) {
      datasource.options.select += ',customfield';
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Handle data loading events
 */
onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.onAfterLoadData\`;
  
  if (datasource.name === 'woListDS') {
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Loaded \${items.length} work orders\`);
    
    // Process each loaded item
    items.forEach(item => {
      // Add computed fields
      item.isHighPriority = item.priority > 3;
      item.isOverdue = new Date(item.schedfinish) < new Date();
    });
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Pattern 4: Dialog Customization`}</h4>
    <p>{`Customize dialog behavior during initialization:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Called when a dialog is initialized
 * @param {Object} dialog - The dialog instance
 */
dialogInitialized(dialog) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.dialogInitialized\`;
  this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Dialog initialized: \${dialog.name}\`);
  
  if (dialog.name === 'woStatusChangeDialog') {
    const controller = dialog.findController((c) => c.constructor.name === 'ChangeStatusController');
    
    if (!controller) {
      this.app.log.w(TAG, 'ChangeStatusController not found');
      return;
    }
    
    // Save reference to original method
    const originalChangeStatus = controller.changeStatus.bind(controller);
    
    // Replace with custom version
    controller.changeStatus = async (evt) => {
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Custom status change logic');
      
      // Add custom validation
      if (!this.validateStatusChange(evt)) {
        this.app.toast('Status change not allowed', 'error');
        return;
      }
      
      // Call original method
      await originalChangeStatus(evt);
      
      // Add custom post-processing
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Status change completed');
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Validate status change
 */
validateStatusChange(evt) {
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.validateStatusChange\`;
  this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Validating status change');
  
  // Add your validation logic
  return true;
}
`}</code></pre>

    <h3>{`Best Practices`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`✅ Do:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Place all custom business logic in this file`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use clear, descriptive function names`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add comprehensive comments explaining the purpose of each customization`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`TAG`}</inlineCode>{` constant for consistent logging`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Test customizations after each Maximo Mobile upgrade`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Monitor release notes for deprecated APIs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Wrap original methods when extending functionality (preserve base behavior)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`bind()`}</inlineCode>{` when saving method references to preserve context`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Implement event handlers for any component (datasource, dialog, page, app)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`❌ Don’t:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Assume APIs will remain unchanged between versions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Skip testing after upgrades`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Mix custom logic with base framework files`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Ignore deprecation warnings in release notes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Modify the file structure or class name`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Remove the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`export default`}</inlineCode>{` statement`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Handling API Changes During Upgrades`}</h3>
    <p>{`When upgrading Maximo Mobile versions, you may need to adjust your `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` code to accommodate API changes:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Example: Handling deprecated API
 * Version 8.3: Used app.datasources.workorderDS
 * Version 8.4: Changed to app.findDatasource('workorderDS')
 */
applicationInitialized(app) {
  this.app = app;
  const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.applicationInitialized\`;
  
  // Get datasource using version-appropriate method
  let woDS;
  
  try {
    // Try new API first (8.4+)
    woDS = this.app.findDatasource('workorderDS');
  } catch (error) {
    // Fall back to legacy API (8.3 and earlier)
    this.app.log.w(methodTag, 'Using legacy datasource API');
    woDS = this.app.datasources?.workorderDS;
  }
  
  if (woDS) {
    this.applyCustomConfiguration(woDS);
  } else {
    this.app.log.e(methodTag, 'Work order datasource not found');
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Real-World Example`}</h3>
    <p>{`Here’s a complete example showing multiple customization patterns:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Custom Application Logic for Technician App
 * Adds validation, logging, and custom business rules
 * Acts as global controller for all application events
 */
const TAG = 'TechnicianCustom';

class AppCustomizations {
  
  applicationInitialized(app) {
    this.app = app;
    this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Technician customizations initialized');
    
    // Register event handlers
    this.registerEventHandlers();
  }
  
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.pageInitialized\`;
    
    if (page.name === 'workDetail') {
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Customizing work detail page');
      this.customizeWorkDetailPage(page);
    }
  }
  
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.onDatasourceInitialized\`;
    
    if (datasource.name === 'workorderDS') {
      this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Customizing work order datasource');
      // Add custom datasource configuration
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Register application-wide event handlers
   */
  registerEventHandlers() {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.registerEventHandlers\`;
    
    // Track work order status changes
    this.app.on('onValueChanged', (event) => {
      const { datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue } = event;
      
      if (datasource.name === 'workorderDS' && field === 'status') {
        this.app.log.i(methodTag, 
          \`WO \${item.wonum} status: \${oldValue} → \${newValue}\`);
        
        // Auto-populate fields based on status
        if (newValue === 'COMP' && !item.actfinish) {
          item.actfinish = new Date();
          this.app.log.d(methodTag, 'Auto-populated actual finish date');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  /**
   * Customize work detail page
   */
  customizeWorkDetailPage(page) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.customizeWorkDetailPage\`;
    const controller = page.findController((c) => c.constructor.name === 'WorkOrderDetailController');
    
    if (!controller) {
      this.app.log.w(methodTag, 'WorkOrderDetailController not found');
      return;
    }
    
    // Wrap save method
    const originalSave = controller.saveWorkOrder?.bind(controller);
    
    if (originalSave) {
      controller.saveWorkOrder = async function() {
        const saveTag = \`\${TAG}.saveWorkOrder\`;
        this.app.log.d(saveTag, 'Custom save validation');
        
        const woDS = page.findDatasource('workorderDS');
        if (!woDS || !woDS.item) {
          this.app.log.w(saveTag, 'Work order datasource or item not found');
          return false;
        }
        
        const workorder = woDS.item;
        
        // Custom validation: Completed WOs must have labor costs
        if (workorder.status === 'COMP') {
          if (!workorder.actlabcost || workorder.actlabcost <= 0) {
            this.app.toast(
              'Labor cost is required for completed work orders',
              'error'
            );
            return false;
          }
        }
        
        // Call original save
        const result = await originalSave();
        
        // Post-save actions
        if (result) {
          this.app.log.i(saveTag, \`Work order \${workorder.wonum} saved\`);
        }
        
        return result;
      }.bind(controller);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Custom event handler called from XML
   */
  handleCustomAction(item) {
    const methodTag = \`\${TAG}.handleCustomAction\`;
    this.app.log.d(methodTag, \`Custom action for WO: \${item.wonum}\`);
    
    // Implement custom business logic
    this.app.toast(\`Processing \${item.wonum}\`, 'info');
  }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Summary`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` file is your primary tool for customizing Maximo Mobile applications. It provides:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Upgrade safety`}</strong>{` - Your customizations persist through version updates`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Global controller`}</strong>{` - Can handle events from any component in the application`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Centralized management`}</strong>{` - All custom logic in one place`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Flexibility`}</strong>{` - Can wrap, extend, or add new functionality`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Maintainability`}</strong>{` - Clear separation from base framework code`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Event interception`}</strong>{` - Can intercept and customize any application event`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`While you may need to adjust for API changes between versions, this approach is far superior to directly modifying base controllers, which would require complete reapplication after each upgrade.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong></p>

      <li parentName="ul"><a parentName="li" {...{

      <li parentName="ul"><a parentName="li" {...{

        }}>{`Replace Existing Method`}</a></li>
    </ul>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Method 2: Extending Base JavaScript Classes (Recommended)`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Overview`}</h3>
    <p>{`For more complex customizations, extending base JavaScript classes provides a structured, object-oriented approach that maintains separation between custom and base code while surviving upgrades. This method is particularly useful when `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js`}</inlineCode>{` becomes too large or when you need to create reusable controller logic.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Why Extend Classes`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Benefits:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`No manual reapplication`}</strong>{` - Custom logic doesn’t need to be manually merged after upgrades`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Object-oriented`}</strong>{` - Leverages inheritance for clean code organization`}</li>

    <h3>{`Creating an Extended Controller Class`}</h3>
    <h4>{`Step 1: Create the Extended Controller File`}</h4>
    <p>{`Create a new JavaScript file with a unique name. The file should import the base controller and the logging utility:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * ExtendedSchedulePageController.js
 * Extended controller for schedule page
 * Location: /app/controllers/extended/ExtendedSchedulePageController.js
 */
import { log } from "@maximo/maximo-js-api";
import SchedulePageController from "../SchedulePageController";

const TAG = "ExtendedSchedulePageController";

/**
 * ExtendedSchedulePageController extends SchedulePageController
 * to provide additional functionality and customizations.
 */
class ExtendedSchedulePageController extends SchedulePageController {
  /**
   * Constructor for ExtendedSchedulePageController
   */
  constructor() {
    super();
    log.t(TAG, "ExtendedSchedulePageController initialized");
  }

  /**
   * Override pageInitialized to add custom initialization logic
   * Always call super to preserve base functionality
   * @param {Object} page - The page object
   * @param {Object} app - The application object
   */
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    log.t(TAG, "Extended Page Initialized");
    
    // Call parent class initialization first
    super.pageInitialized(page, app);
    
    // Add custom initialization logic here
    this.initializeCustomFeatures();
  }

  /**
   * Initialize custom features
   */
  initializeCustomFeatures() {
    log.t(TAG, "Initializing custom features");
    
    // Example: Set custom state
    this.page.state.customProperty = true;
    this.page.state.lastModified = new Date();
    
    // Example: Register custom event handlers
    this.page.on('custom-event', this.handleCustomEvent.bind(this));
  }

  /**
   * Override existing method with custom logic
   * Example: Override save method
   */
  async saveWorkOrder() {
    log.t(TAG, "Custom save logic executing");
    
    // Custom pre-save validation
    if (!this.validateCustomRequirements()) {
      this.app.toast('Custom validation failed', 'error');
      return false;
    }
    
    // Call parent save method
    const result = await super.saveWorkOrder();
    
    // Custom post-save logic
    if (result) {
      await this.performCustomPostSaveActions();
    }
    
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Add new custom method (not in base class)
   */
  validateCustomRequirements() {
    log.t(TAG, "Performing custom validation");
    
    const woDS = this.page.findDatasource('workorderDS');
    if (!woDS || !woDS.item) {
      log.w(TAG, 'Work order datasource or item not found');
      return false;
    }
    
    const workorder = woDS.item;
    
    // Custom validation logic
    if (workorder.status === 'COMP') {
      if (!workorder.actfinish) {
        log.w(TAG, 'Actual finish date missing');
        return false;
      }
    }
    
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Custom post-save actions
   */
  async performCustomPostSaveActions() {
    log.t(TAG, "Executing post-save actions");
    
    const woDS = this.page.findDatasource('workorderDS');
    if (!woDS || !woDS.item) {
      log.w(TAG, 'Work order datasource or item not found');
      return;
    }
    
    // Add your custom post-save logic
    const workorder = woDS.item;
    log.i(TAG, \`Work order \${workorder.wonum} saved successfully\`);
  }

  /**
   * Custom event handler
   */
  handleCustomEvent(event) {
    log.t(TAG, "Handling custom event", event);
    
    // Custom event handling logic
    this.page.state.lastModified = new Date();
  }
}

export default ExtendedSchedulePageController;
`}</code></pre>
